content: Diet tracking apps fail long-term due to friction, uncertainty, guilt and clutter around tracking rather than tracking itself (kibora.app, 2026). Top data-quality killers: duplicate/double-logged entries, wrong barcode scan results, and forgotten bites/sips causing systematic underestimation; inconsistent logs directly undermine user trust in the saldo/numbers (nutrola.app, fitia.app). Implication for MCP-based logging: echo-back confirmations, undo commands and single-write idempotency are trust features, not extras.
